description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Multiversal Incursion, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Multiversal Incursion, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
